page.overview:
Who is STD Devil?

The の|Seibyō no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of sexually transmitted diseases.

The STD Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The STD Devil's personality is currently unknown, though as it agreed to make a contract with a 14-year-old, showing it evidently has fairly depraved morals.

At the age of 14, Fumiko Mifune made a contract with the STD Devil.
